description: C46 (10-01, floor-clear mandate): COMBAT only, the Basement I boss rooms and the normal rooms (1x1 and the other shapes) 1:1 by steps, start half hearts uniform 2-6 (what a floor run brings to a room); boss HP start randomisation from the command line (--boss-hp-prob / --boss-hp-min); navigation is scripted in the floor runner, so no GOTO groups.
